contract: The selected MPEG-TS program driven through each source polling form. Each feed callback requests ordinary source delivery. The candidate reads the active program after every accepted PMT.

The candidate folds each validated PES in publication order. It places raw 33-bit time in period zero and preserves DTS absence. The source carrier start is derived from the first header range and the supplied packet size. Validated PES projects zero duration and flags and its original stream ID.
Trace identifies accepted program entries, raw headers, payload spans and source diagnostics. The reference exposes the packet fold, including its demux clock and flags.

Check original carrier and PSI ranges, PAT association order, active PMT views, continuity counter transitions and duplicate bytes, compact null runs, selected PCR boundaries and the physical entity end on all five forms. Require each retained rejected carrier to match its original source range.

The pinned formats worker opens the selected program with public MPEG-TS AVIO, NOPARSE and NOFILLIN, without stream discovery. It delivers ordinary entities in one AVIO source and flushes at a declared discontinuity.

The packet fold is the mpegts-pes fold: stream index, PID, PTS and DTS in 90 kHz ticks (INT64_MIN for absence), duration, position, flags, size, bytes and every side-data element. Input loading is outside the run. Both sides drain the last entity to logical end.
Every operation in the mpegts-pes corpus runs for each form, retaining its 272 request mappings and the hash of every ordered input.
Candidate header and payload source ranges are checked against the preloaded entity bytes. Partial progress and the public header flags are traced.
The source-clocks profile uses the public demux clock reduced to 33 bits, encoded timestamp presence from the PES start on the original carrier grid, and the physical start carrier offset for M2TS.

open_deviations.reading: A legal duplicate transport packet carries no new payload
open_deviations.clause: ITU-T H.222.0 (08/2023) §2.4.3.3 permits one consecutive copy of a payload-carrying packet on a PID, byte-identical apart from a valid PCR, as a duplicate of the first.
open_deviations.candidate: Delivers each original PES once with its own payload, position and clock.
open_deviations.reference: Delivers the duplicate's payload too: repeats the PES or merges the duplicate bytes into it, sometimes splitting it.
open_deviations.compat: compat::pes::DemuxObserver cuts the demuxer's PES packets from this input (its ts-observer-forms cases pass)

open_deviations.reading: A scrambled transport payload is not a clear PES
open_deviations.clause: ITU-T H.222.0 (08/2023) §2.4.3.3 and Table 2-4: transport_scrambling_control 10 scrambles the whole packet payload, the PES header included.
open_deviations.candidate: Publishes no PES from the scrambled carrier and reports the scrambling as a source diagnostic.
open_deviations.reference: Parses the scrambled payload as a clear PES and returns its 27 bytes at PTS 90000.
open_deviations.compat: compat::pes::TransportFaultRecovery with PesFaultPolicy extracts the demuxer's PES from a finite TS188 AVC carrier with this fault (ts-fault-facts transport-scrambled passes)

open_deviations.reading: An excess copy of a transport packet: a recovery policy no standard decides
open_deviations.clause: ITU-T H.222.0 (08/2023) §2.4.3.3 allows at most two consecutive packets with one continuity_counter value; the clause makes the input nonconforming and does not say what a receiver delivers from it.
open_deviations.candidate: Our rule (triergon-mpegts README, Recovery from nonconforming input): the excess copy discards the PES assembly it interrupts; a PES already published stays and assembly resumes at the next unit start.
open_deviations.reference: Observed rule: no duplicate detection; the copies' payload is delivered or merged into the affected PES.
open_deviations.compat: compat::pes::DemuxObserver cuts the demuxer's PES packets from this input (its ts-observer-forms cases pass)

open_deviations.reading: A PES interrupted by a continuity-counter gap: a recovery policy no standard decides
open_deviations.clause: ITU-T H.222.0 (08/2023) §2.4.3.3 defines continuity_counter per PID, so a gap means lost packets; the clause makes the input nonconforming and does not say what a receiver delivers from it.
open_deviations.candidate: Our rule (triergon-mpegts README, Recovery from nonconforming input): a lost packet discards the partial PES it interrupts; the next complete PES is published.
open_deviations.reference: Observed rule: publishes the available bytes flagged corrupt and continues at the next unit start.
open_deviations.compat: compat::pes::DemuxObserver cuts the demuxer's PES packets from this input (its ts-observer-forms cases pass)

open_deviations.reading: A PES in a carrier whose PCR extension is out of range: a recovery policy no standard decides
open_deviations.clause: ITU-T H.222.0 (08/2023) §2.4.3.5 codes program_clock_reference_extension modulo 300; the clause makes the input nonconforming and does not say what a receiver delivers from it.
open_deviations.candidate: Our rule (triergon-mpegts README, Recovery from nonconforming input): the carrier with an invalid PCR is rejected with its payload, so no PES comes from it.
open_deviations.reference: Observed rule: ignores the extension and returns the 27-byte PES at PTS 90000.
open_deviations.compat: compat::pes::TransportFaultRecovery with PesFaultPolicy extracts the demuxer's PES from a finite TS188 AVC carrier with this fault (ts-fault-facts pcr-extension-invalid passes)

open_deviations.reading: A PES in a carrier that codes OPCR without PCR: a recovery policy no standard decides
open_deviations.clause: ITU-T H.222.0 (08/2023) §2.4.3.5 allows OPCR only in a packet that carries PCR; the clause makes the input nonconforming and does not say what a receiver delivers from it.
open_deviations.candidate: Our rule (triergon-mpegts README, Recovery from nonconforming input): the carrier with the unpaired OPCR is rejected with its payload; no PES is published from this input.
open_deviations.reference: Observed rule: ignores the OPCR and returns both 27-byte PES.
open_deviations.compat: compat::pes::TransportFaultRecovery with PesFaultPolicy extracts the demuxer's PES from a finite TS188 AVC carrier with this fault (ts-fault-facts opcr-without-pcr-invalid passes)

open_deviations.reading: A PES in a carrier with the transport error indicator set: a recovery policy no standard decides
open_deviations.clause: ITU-T H.222.0 (08/2023) §2.4.3.3 defines transport_error_indicator as at least one uncorrectable bit error in the packet; the clause makes the input nonconforming and does not say what a receiver delivers from it.
open_deviations.candidate: Our rule (triergon-mpegts README, Recovery from nonconforming input): the errored carrier's payload is discarded and its PES is not published.
open_deviations.reference: Observed rule: delivers the 27 bytes at PTS 90000 without a corrupt flag.
open_deviations.compat: compat::pes::TransportFaultRecovery with PesFaultPolicy extracts the demuxer's PES from a finite TS188 AVC carrier with this fault (ts-fault-facts transport-tei passes)

open_deviations.reading: A PES header with a zero timestamp marker bit: a recovery policy no standard decides
open_deviations.clause: ITU-T H.222.0 (08/2023) §2.4.3.7 Table 2-21 requires each PTS marker_bit to be 1; the clause makes the input nonconforming and does not say what a receiver delivers from it.
open_deviations.candidate: Our rule (triergon-mpegts README, Recovery from nonconforming input): the malformed header is rejected and its PES is not published.
open_deviations.reference: Observed rule: reads the timestamp regardless and returns the 27 bytes with PTS and DTS 90000.
open_deviations.compat: compat::pes::TransportFaultRecovery with PesFaultPolicy extracts the demuxer's PES from a finite TS188 AVC carrier with this fault (ts-fault-facts pes-timestamp-marker passes)

open_deviations.reading: A PES header with PTS_DTS_flags 01: a recovery policy no standard decides
open_deviations.clause: ITU-T H.222.0 (08/2023) §2.4.3.7 forbids PTS_DTS_flags value 01; the clause makes the input nonconforming and does not say what a receiver delivers from it.
open_deviations.candidate: Our rule (triergon-mpegts README, Recovery from nonconforming input): the malformed header is rejected and its PES is not published.
open_deviations.reference: Observed rule: returns the 27 bytes with neither clock.
open_deviations.compat: compat::pes::TransportFaultRecovery with PesFaultPolicy extracts the demuxer's PES from a finite TS188 AVC carrier with this fault (ts-fault-facts pes-forbidden-time-flags passes)

open_deviations.reading: A finite PES that ends before its declared length: a recovery policy no standard decides
open_deviations.clause: ITU-T H.222.0 (08/2023) §2.4.3.7 PES_packet_length declares more bytes than the input holds; the clause makes the input nonconforming and does not say what a receiver delivers from it.
open_deviations.candidate: Our rule (triergon-mpegts README, Recovery from nonconforming input): an incomplete finite PES is not published.
open_deviations.reference: Observed rule: publishes the 24 available bytes flagged corrupt.
open_deviations.compat: compat::pes::DemuxObserver cuts the demuxer's PES packets from this input (its ts-observer-forms cases pass)

open_deviations.reading: An audio PES with PES_packet_length zero: a recovery policy no standard decides
open_deviations.clause: ITU-T H.222.0 (08/2023) §2.4.3.7 allows PES_packet_length 0 only for a video elementary stream in TS; the clause makes the input nonconforming and does not say what a receiver delivers from it.
open_deviations.candidate: Our rule (triergon-mpegts README, Recovery from nonconforming input): the unbounded audio PES is rejected.
open_deviations.reference: Observed rule: returns its 27 bytes at PTS 90000.
open_deviations.compat: compat::pes::DemuxObserver cuts the demuxer's PES packets from this input (its ts-observer-forms cases pass)

open_deviations.reading: Continuation payload past a finite PES's declared extent: a recovery policy no standard decides
open_deviations.clause: ITU-T H.222.0 (08/2023) §§2.4.3.3 and 2.4.3.7: a carrier without payload_unit_start_indicator continues a PES past its PES_packet_length; the clause makes the input nonconforming and does not say what a receiver delivers from it.
open_deviations.candidate: Our rule (triergon-mpegts README, Recovery from nonconforming input): the PES is published with the 400 bytes its PES_packet_length declares, and the bytes past that length in its last carrier are reported after it as a separate Pes fault.
open_deviations.reference: Observed rule: publishes all 401 to 415 carried bytes in two packets, the first 354 bytes flagged corrupt with the PES clocks and the remaining 47 to 61 bytes without clocks; that second packet starts no PES, so these cases compare demux clocks without the source-clocks projection.
open_deviations.compat: compat::pes::DemuxObserver cuts the demuxer's PES packets from this input (its ts-observer-forms cases pass)
